Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 50 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 50% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 7. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Only supply of Goods 8. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses A. Please mention bid number, item number and bidder details clearly and legibly. B. The bidder will be rejected on the following grounds:

a) The bidder shall quote the bids for the items in accordance with technical specifications as men tioned in the bid document. Any discrepancy will not be considered and such bids shall be treated as rejected OR b) If the sample is not approved by the hospital authorities OR c) Any bidder who has been declared defaulter with respect to supply of items in this hospital. d) the bidder fails to submit the sample and other relevant documents as mentioned in the bid. C. The supplies are required in 1 instalment withing 30 days D. The products being supplied must have minimum shelf life of 2 years. On the date of supply, mi nimum usable shelf life should be available. E. As per CVC guidelines, the OEM and Reseller should not participate in the tender simultaneousl y and in the case, both bids will be disqualified. F. Exemption on qualification criteria will be provided as per the latest Government orders upon v erification of suitable valid supportive documents submitted by the bidder. G. All the self certificates asked in this tender should be provided in bidder's letterhead. H. Bidders are requested to state the compliance of each specification whether the quoted item is complying with the technical specification as per technical compliance sheet. Technical bids with a ny non-compliance / false information / not giving any supportive document/brochures not contain ing the required details/not provided technical compliance sheet as per format will be disqualified at the technical evaluation stage. I. OFFERS RECEIVED FROM BIDDERS WITH SAME IP ADDRESS WILL BE TREATED AS “ REJECT ED” AND WI LL NOT BE CONSIDERED FOR EVALUATION. J. The product quoted should comply with the CDSCO certificate.
